Your Recipients, Witnesses, and Depositaries are proposed here to avoid you having to recreate them — but they are two different things: it is only their status as Recipient, in your Trust Circle, that will one day give them access to your memories.

resources.string: Those who will receive your memories
No one in your circle has access to your content today. Your legacy remains sealed until the protocol is activated by your depositaries.
Your intimate space to capture and transmit what really matters. Let\'s learn together how it works.
Text, voice or photo. Everything is encrypted immediately. The AI organizes your memories into the right emotional drawers for you.
It\'s your signature. Each thought is marked with your exact age. Your loved ones will see your evolution through time.
Choose who will receive your messages. You can even schedule sends for the future (ex: a child\'s 18th birthday).
Your memories are protected by state-of-the-art encryption (E2EE). They can only be opened by you and your designated loved ones.
Add your essential books, movies, and music.
Your library reveals a deep attachment to adventure stories and melancholy music. Your choices often revolve around the theme of discovery.

A Time Capsule is a memory that you schedule to open on a precise date chosen in advance — a birthday, an upcoming wedding, a date that matters to you. The recipient cannot open it before that date: it appears in their Mailbox with the opening date displayed in the meantime. Once scheduled, the date can no longer be modified directly — the capsule must be deleted and recreated if you want to change the date.
Capture memories to see them organized here.

The Mirror for Two is a two-voiced message that you compose with a chosen person — each person writes their version on their side, in total confidentiality. The content is not revealed to anyone, not even the two of you, until both have clicked on \'I have finished my version\'. You can also choose, each on your side, if this Mirror for Two should feed your Book of My Life or remain a private exchange between you two.
